scope: Backend/runtime prepublication review; isolated verification only.
evidence_basis: Previously observed executions in this review; no tests repeated for this summary.

relevant_coverage: Six public record kinds and historical aliases
Immutable revisions and historical receipt replay
Codex installer configuration preservation and credential handling

isolated_date_api_smoke.transport: In-process FastAPI TestClient with an isolated SQLite database
checks: Capture created_at stays unchanged after automatic concept enrichment.
Changed concept assignments advance capture updated_at and revision_created_at.
Historical source_get preserves the requested revision_created_at.
Historical source_get retains the capture created_at and current capture updated_at.
Month-precision event_time remains a month value.

wheel_build_and_smoke.method: Extracted the built wheel outside the checkout and imported that package in a subprocess using the existing dependency environment; this was not a fresh dependency installation.
checks: Imported database module comes from the extracted wheel.
Packaged migrations initialize an isolated database.
Isolated application health, session issuance, CSRF-protected record creation succeed.
Packaged migration runs again successfully after application shutdown.
Frontend bundle is absent, consistent with documented source-checkout deployment.

review_conclusion: No new blocking functional or security regression was identified within the reviewed scope; this is not a general security certification.
limitations: Native Windows/macOS and broader Linux hardware support were not exercised.
Real-account logout/login and hosted GitHub Actions were not exercised.
Wheel smoke reused existing dependencies and did not validate a clean-machine dependency install.
Wheel alone is not a complete web application distribution; frontend assets are not bundled.
PII redaction covers configured email, credit-card and IP detectors, not all personal or sensitive information.
Canonical storage is local, while answer generation and automatic concept classification send model inputs to the selected external provider.
Large-corpus performance, deep general source recursion and concept-classification input quality remain follow-up work.
